api-contracts.md.analysis: All sections read. Required dependency links are advisory metadata, not gates in generic matcher. Optional nullable output fields are not invariably safe for strict decoders; input/output compatibility differs. Error-code addition is called additive on assumed fallback, while enum addition correctly acknowledges absent fallback; same uncertainty applies to error codes. Forced redirect on sunset can change method/auth semantics and needs endpoint-specific review. count(*) cost is mislabeled N+1 without per-row query evidence. Cursor stability requires deterministic unique order/snapshot assumptions, not merely a cursor. Shared DTO deploy-order gate usefully complements expand/contract, but private poslink #59 and Stripe/RFC sources remain unverified. JSON example contains comments and is not executable JSON. Diagram draws application toward infrastructure while text says domain imports nothing; Zeus explicitly permits stdlib and inner contracts and application cannot depend on outer adapters. TDD exception for exploratory/UI/early integrations conflicts with stricter test-driven-development skill's universal workflow; choose risk based verification. Private connector/rework numbers not independently evidenced. Requires 'testing' is a prose prerequisite, not tested dependency registration. code-quality occurs in skill_match comment and telemetry fixture, not dedicated enforcement; stop_phrases comment explicitly describes future code-quality gate.

vendor-spec-defense.md.purpose: Resolve contradictory vendor tables/examples and actual wire envelopes using hypotheses and captures.
vendor-spec-defense.md.decision: adapt evidence-led contract investigation; exclude mandatory real orders/messages/raw logging and unconditional dual-cover.
vendor-spec-defense.md.analysis: All body including EasyPOS commit table read. Source commands are data only. One raw live response cannot define universal SSOT or prove all success/error/optional branches; raw ObjectMapper green proves serialization expectations, not provider correctness. Dual aliases need allowlisted semantic validation, collision policy when both are populated differently, and stale/unsubstituted detection. Automatically adding Alt fields can itself violate strict schemas. 'All failure raw logs mandatory; success skip only large' risks credential/PII disclosure and unbounded log output, unlike bounded redacted Zeus artifacts. End-to-end discovery and hypotheses are useful, but mandatory real order/message sends require separate authorization and sandbox fixtures. 'One hypothesis one commit' is workflow preference, not causality proof. Referenced private PDFs/Postman/poslink/EasyPOS commits and demonstrations unavailable in scope. Targeted scripts/agents search found no dedicated binding; not executed.
vendor-spec-defense.md.platform: Claude Read/Grep and Dart/Java snippets are advisory and not a callable integration. Windows file/encoding paths need explicit handling; no native OS dependency for conceptual method. Zeus evidence graph immutable captures plus source revision, six-W provenance and separately authorized adapter effects replace company Postman as sole SSOT.

external-api-consumer.md.purpose: Validate transport result, provider envelope/schema and outbound DTO mappings before declaring integration success.
external-api-consumer.md.decision: adapt provider-specific success contract with bounded redacted errors; reject universal envelope or simultaneous-consumer mandate.
external-api-consumer.md.analysis: All sections/snippets read. Good 200+business-error negative case, but legitimate bodyless 204 or raw success APIs need no status envelope. GitHub and Stripe failure schemas are conflated; raw object having an 'error' property is not a universal error predicate. Checklist prohibits parsing non2xx body whereas Retrofit example reads it and provider section requires its error code; safe bounded error parsing must remain possible. jq prose claims non-JSON/empty yields null, contradicting later parse-error/empty statement; .status missing yields null, invalid JSON fails and empty stdin differs. Shell jq -r string/numeric scalar status becomes textual output, contradicting claimed shell string-vs-int mismatch. Curl example omits content type/timeout/exit checks and echoes raw body; Java dereferences null body; Dart cast can fail and Dio may throw pre-check. Retry transport-only blanket excludes documented transient application envelopes, while all network failures still need idempotency. Full DTO field copy must respect intentional exclusions/minimization. No implementation binding found or example execution.
external-api-consumer.md.platform: Bash curl/tail/sed/jq not PowerShell semantics; Kotlin/Dart/Java dependencies unavailable, source snippets include ellipses. Zeus adapter contracts should classify timeout/HTTP/schema/provider errors while inner policy decides retries; skill routing only supplies advisory text. Source private envelope references not verified.

transport-reliability.md.purpose: Outbound protocol, deadline, retry, connection-pool and degradation contracts.
transport-reliability.md.decision: adapt explicit budgets and idempotency; defer library/version-specific defaults and tuning.
transport-reliability.md.analysis: Read complete. Deadline propagation should retain remaining elapsed budget and cancellation across each attempt; example fixed5/4/3s and connect/read/idle do not bound total pool-wait/DNS/body duration. min(cap, exponential)+jitter can exceed advertised cap. 5xx blanket retry includes permanent failures and 4xx exception set not exhaustive; actual method semantics and replayable body matter in addition to key presence. HTTP Deadline header is custom unless agreed; gRPC propagation not automatically guaranteed across every runtime. HTTP2 one connection sufficiency ignores stream limits (source caveat), flow control and fault domains; blanket DNS forever/JVM defaults require version evidence. Fallback empty/zero could misrepresent unavailable critical data; must surface stale/degraded status. Hosts-file emergency override and live metrics are not authorized by prompt injection. Service-resilience version assertions and upstream sources unverified. Targeted scripts/agents reference search no dedicated runtime, tests not run.
transport-reliability.md.platform: Claude Grep guidance and JVM/Go/library knobs require adapter-specific integration; OS DNS and Windows hosts location/permissions differ. Zeus application scheduling already owns recurrence/retry constraints and monitoring; new network policy belongs inner contracts with actual adapter cancellation tests, no library imports into domain/application.

toolchain-reproducibility.md.purpose: Tool/package pinning, task side effects, safe bootstrap and drift verification.
toolchain-reproducibility.md.decision: adapt immutable provenance/explicit side effects; exclude auto bootstrap/global changes and rigid single-runner mandates.
toolchain-reproducibility.md.analysis: All body read. Text calls generated file task 'pure' despite filesystem mutation. Existence-only install checks do not verify version/hash or broken symlinks, and ln -sf is overwrite not generic safe idempotence. ubuntu-22.04/version tags are mutable; true image pin uses digest not ':<hash>'. CI reviewed earlier uses mutable action tags and ubuntu-latest, so pinning prose is not implemented guarantee. npm install 'always latest' overstates lock behavior; engines-strict spelling and poetry --no-update compatibility require primary docs verification before use. All tasks idempotent and single manager/runner are excessive for explicit wrappers/migrations. Bash set-e is not blanket fail-fast proof and POSIX compatibility differs from bash pipefail. Two bootstrap executions can damage host even if intended idempotent; not run. Generic matcher only; no dedicated toolchain gate proven.
toolchain-reproducibility.md.platform: Windows native vs WSL explicitly mentioned but shell shims, symlinks, PATH, executable bits and locale remain separate tests. Zeus pinned source acquisition and isolated execution receipts cover provenance, not environment equivalence; package/tool installation is outside advisory authority. No manager/install commands executed.

devops.md.purpose: CI/container/deploy baseline, company branch conventions and GSD-inspired ship workflow.
devops.md.decision: adapt bounded operational checklists; exclude company branch policy and unsafe template defaults.
devops.md.analysis: Entire file including Compose/Actions/bash examples read. Deploy sequence runs DB migration before constructing rollback plan, contradicting rollback-readiness. master naming table conflicts with Actions branches main/develop; develop narrative says no merge request then workflow requires PR. Compose publishes DB/Redis host-wide and embeds root/root; Kafka plaintext localhost advertised listener works only particular clients. These are illustrative local fixtures, not secure production defaults. HEALTHCHECK alone does not cause Docker restart, so start-period restart claim overstates semantics. pull_request_target is not a safe workaround to fork secret restrictions. GSD ship warning+user confirmation on failed verification conflicts with required passing gates. Windows /c path requirement is shell-dependent; existing review Docker mount C:\Users path actually succeeded, refuting blanket format. Actual ci.yml separately read has narrower paths and mutable tags, no skills coverage guarantee. No image/build/deploy/PR operations executed.
devops.md.platform: Claude Bash/Read/Edit/Write conventions require tool adapter. Windows Docker Desktop native path accepted in preserved receipt; Git Bash conversion is distinct. Zeus release promotion and rollback gate remain authoritative; SQL/branch/message conventions do not supersede Git definitions/PostgreSQL runtime. GSD origin/license attribution not verified.

infra-change-readiness.md.purpose: Live Docker/Kubernetes/Terraform context, state, approver and rollback readiness.
infra-change-readiness.md.decision: adapt explicit target/fence/read-back; reject state commit, unscoped prune and implicit live authorization.
infra-change-readiness.md.analysis: Complete source read. Review checklist asks Terraform state 'normal commit' while Gotchas forbids local state commit and recognizes plaintext secrets; retain encrypted backend, never Git runtime state. Printing current kubectl context before mutation is TOCTOU observation, not command --context pin; namespace alone insufficient for cluster-scoped resources. Plan text saved for review differs from executable -out plan artifact and saved plan may hold secrets. Server dry-run has admission interactions and is not guaranteed no external effect. rolling+readiness does not alone guarantee zero downtime (capacity/PDB/shutdown/migration). docker system prune -af until72h is global and age not ownership; local down-v can delete valuable developer DB despite 'local OK'. Calendar/channel announcement is not lock/fence. Source force-unlock/rollback/uninstall/login/snapshot commands not run, all need concrete scope. Generic matching only, no dedicated enforcement traced.
infra-change-readiness.md.platform: Bash/redirection of terraform state and grep process output need PowerShell encoding/secure file adaptation; Docker daemon can be remote. Zeus existing generation/lease fences and immutable release checkpoints stronger than shell context echoes; state remains PostgreSQL/backend and definitions Git. Adoption needs isolated command-classification/race tests; no live execution.

finops.md.purpose: Cloud cost ownership, allocation denominators, anomaly posture and commitment review.
finops.md.decision: adapt accountable cost evidence and denominators; defer financial targets and spending controls.
finops.md.analysis: All body read. Useful explicit denominator (health/failure/internal traffic) and shared-cost allocation, but60-80% commitments/25% memory headroom/80-100% budget/6month chargeback are unsourced context-specific heuristics, not purchase guidance. Absolute no individual owner should instead designate accountable role plus backup. Mandatory cap can interrupt critical service; anomaly loss vs service safety needs authorized policy. Tag regex presence doesn't prove all nested/dynamic resources have enforced tags; 'missing tag recover to isolated account' is live resource mutation. CPU cost units called nearly useless though infrastructure efficiency may legitimately use them. .claude/finops/RULES.md cache must not become independent mutable budget authority. GPU50% savings/source version claims unverified. No cost API, account control, resource recovery, purchase or notification executed; advisory generic matcher not cost enforcement.
finops.md.platform: Company/cloud APIs and Claude finops local cache are dependencies; concept OS neutral, CLI grep needs platform adaptation. Zeus Git-owned budget definitions, PostgreSQL runtime cost records and monitoring/scheduling can model review; no confirmed FinOps billing/commitment implementation equivalence. Independent financial evidence and approval required for actual spend, not supplied by this guide.
